mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate level (indicating accommodative monetary policy) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce discount rates for equity valuations.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20d forward returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals a deteriorating labor market that leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, the 5d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and an increase in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a stagflationary environment that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors price in both lower growth and higher inflation.
failure_condition: The interaction term (INDPRO decline and CPIAUCSL rise) fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a weakening real estate sector that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, the 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC for HOUST in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for RSAFS as a predictor of 20d forward returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% signals a weakening manufacturing sector that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where INDPRO declines by more than 0.5%, the 5d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous slowdown in labor market growth (PAYEMS growth rate < 0.2%) and a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) signals a dual stress on the economy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS growth < 0.2% and FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals an unexpected labor market slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, the 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases when PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS in this regime is below 0.03.
